title: Crash Landing on You
description: A South Korean heiress accidentally paraglides into North Korea and falls in love with a military officer who shields her identity.
story: Yoon Se-ri, a successful businesswoman and heiress, is paragliding when a sudden storm forces her to land in North Korea. There she meets Captain Ri Jeong-hyeok, a stoic military officer who decides to help hide her. As the two spend more time together, they fall deeply in love. The drama explores the hardships of a relationship divided by borders, ideology, and impossible circumstances, all while maintaining a warm and often humorous tone.

cast.name: Hyun Bin
cast.bio: South Korean actor born Kim Tae-pyung on September 25, 1982 in Seoul. Rose to fame with My Lovely Sam Soon (2005); Crash Landing on You brought him major international recognition.

cast.name: Son Ye-jin
cast.bio: South Korean actress born January 11, 1982 in Daegu. Known as Korea's 'Nation's First Love' for early romance films; Crash Landing on You made her a global star.

cast.name: Seo Ji-hye
cast.bio: South Korean actress born August 24, 1984 in Seoul. Known for dramas including 49 Days and Punch before her breakout supporting role in Crash Landing on You.

cast.name: Kim Jung-hyun
cast.bio: South Korean actor born April 5, 1990 in Busan. Known for School 2017 and Welcome to Waikiki; gained international recognition through Crash Landing on You.

title: Goblin
description: An immortal Goblin seeks his human bride to end his eternal life, but falls in love with her instead.
story: Kim Shin is a decorated military general from the Goryeo dynasty who was cursed to live as an immortal Goblin. The only way to end his immortal life is to find his human bride who can pull the sword from his chest. He meets Ji Eun-tak, a bubbly high school student with the ability to see ghosts, who is destined to be his bride. As their love grows, both must face the consequences of fate and sacrifice.

cast.name: Gong Yoo
cast.bio: South Korean actor born Gong Ji-cheol on July 10, 1979 in Busan. Known for Coffee Prince (2007) and Train to Busan (2016); won Best Actor at the Baeksang Awards for Goblin.

cast.name: Kim Go-eun
cast.bio: South Korean actress born July 2, 1991 in Seoul. Goblin was one of her breakout television roles, launching her as a leading actress in Korean drama.

cast.name: Lee Dong-wook
cast.bio: South Korean actor born November 6, 1981 in Seoul. Known for My Girl (2005) and Scent of a Woman (2011); later led Tale of the Nine Tailed after Goblin.

cast.name: Yoo In-na
cast.bio: South Korean actress born June 5, 1982 in Seongnam. Known for My Love from the Star (2013); won Best Supporting Actress honors for her role in Goblin.

title: Itaewon Class
description: An ex-convict opens a small bar in Itaewon and fights against a powerful food conglomerate that destroyed his family.
story: Park Saeroyi's life is shattered when his father is killed in a hit-and-run by the son of a powerful food company CEO. After serving time in prison for assaulting the culprit, Saeroyi vows revenge - not through violence, but by building a thriving business empire to outcompete the conglomerate. With the help of a sharp-tongued manager, Jo Yi-seo, and a loyal crew of misfits, he embarks on a journey of grit, ambition, and justice.

cast.name: Park Seo-joon
cast.bio: South Korean actor born Park Yong-kyu on December 16, 1988 in Seoul. Known for What's Wrong with Secretary Kim (2018); Itaewon Class further established him as a leading actor.

cast.name: Kim Da-mi
cast.bio: South Korean actress born April 9, 1995 in Seoul. First gained recognition in The Witch: Part 1 (2018); her role in Itaewon Class won her Best New Actress at the Baeksang Arts Awards.

cast.name: Yoo Jae-myung
cast.bio: South Korean actor born June 3, 1973 in Busan. Known for Reply 1988 (2015) and Stranger (2017); won Best Supporting Actor for his role in Itaewon Class.

cast.name: Kwon Nara
cast.bio: South Korean actress and former singer born Kwon Ah-yoon on March 13, 1991 in Incheon. A founding member of girl group Hello Venus before transitioning fully into acting.

title: My Love from the Star
description: An alien who has lived on Earth for 400 years falls in love with a top actress just before he must return to his home planet.
story: Do Min-joon is an alien who landed on Earth during the Joseon dynasty and has been living as a human ever since. With supernatural abilities and an appearance that never ages, he works as a law professor. He meets Cheon Song-yi, the nation's biggest celebrity, who moves into his apartment building. Despite his desire to keep his distance, Min-joon finds himself falling for her - even as the clock ticks on his imminent departure from Earth.

cast.name: Kim Soo-hyun
cast.bio: South Korean actor who plays Do Min-joon, an alien who has lived on Earth for 400 years.

cast.name: Jun Ji-hyun
cast.bio: South Korean actress who plays Cheon Song-yi, a famous actress whose life changes after meeting Do Min-joon.

cast.name: Park Hae-jin
cast.bio: South Korean actor who plays Lee Hwi-kyung, Song-yi's longtime friend who has loved her since childhood.

cast.name: Yoo In-na
cast.bio: South Korean actress who plays Yoo Se-mi, Song-yi's longtime friend and a fellow actress.

cast.name: Shin Sung-rok
cast.bio: South Korean actor who plays Lee Jae-kyung, Hwi-kyung's older brother and a major antagonist.

cast.name: Ahn Jae-hyun
cast.bio: South Korean actor who plays Cheon Yoon-jae, Song-yi's younger brother.

cast.name: Na Young-hee
cast.bio: South Korean actress who plays Yang Mi-yeon, Cheon Song-yi's mother.

cast.name: Kim Chang-wan
cast.bio: South Korean actor who plays Jang Young-mok, Do Min-joon's lawyer and trusted confidant.

title: Scarlet Heart: Ryeo
description: A modern woman travels back in time to the Goryeo dynasty and becomes entangled in a power struggle among princes.
story: Go Ha-jin, a contemporary woman, is transported back in time to the Goryeo dynasty where she wakes up in the body of a noble girl named Hae Soo. Surrounded by the many princes of the ruling Wang family, she must navigate dangerous court politics, royal rivalries, and the pain of knowing history's cruel outcomes. She falls deeply in love with the brooding fourth prince, Wang So, but destiny may not allow them a happy ending.

cast.name: Lee Joon-gi
cast.bio: South Korean actor born April 17, 1982 in Busan. Rose to fame with The King and the Clown (2005); known for period dramas like Arang and the Magistrate before Moon Lovers.

cast.name: IU
cast.bio: South Korean singer-songwriter and actress born Lee Ji-eun on May 16, 1993 in Seoul. One of Korea's most prominent stars, later known for Hotel Del Luna (2019) and My Mister.

cast.name: Kang Ha-neul
cast.bio: South Korean actor born Kim Ha-neul on February 21, 1990 in Busan. Known for Misaeng: Incomplete Life (2014); later gained international recognition through Squid Game.

title: The Untamed
description: Two cultivators investigate a series of mysterious dark arts crimes that shake the martial world and uncover a conspiracy buried in the past.
story: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji are two young men from rival cultivation clans who meet and develop an unlikely bond while pursuing a shared goal of justice. After a tragedy leads to Wei Wuxian's apparent death, he is resurrected sixteen years later in the body of another man. Together, they investigate a series of supernatural murders that lead back to long-buried secrets and a powerful, ancient evil that threatens the entire cultivation world.

cast.name: Xiao Zhan
cast.bio: Chinese actor who plays Wei Wuxian, a talented cultivator whose journey becomes central to the mysteries of the story.

cast.name: Wang Yibo
cast.bio: Chinese actor who plays Lan Wangji, a disciplined cultivator from the Gusu Lan Clan and Wei Wuxian's close companion.

cast.name: Wang Zhuocheng
cast.bio: Chinese actor who plays Jiang Cheng, a member of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan and Wei Wuxian's martial brother.

cast.name: Xuan Lu
cast.bio: Chinese actress who plays Jiang Yanli, Jiang Cheng's elder sister and an important figure in Wei Wuxian's life.

cast.name: Ji Li
cast.bio: Chinese actor who plays Nie Huaisang, the younger brother of Nie Mingjue and a member of the Qinghe Nie Clan.

cast.name: Yu Bin
cast.bio: Chinese actor who plays Wen Ning, a member of the Wen Clan who develops a strong bond with Wei Wuxian.

cast.name: Liu Haikuan
cast.bio: Chinese actor who plays Lan Xichen, the elder brother of Lan Wangji and leader of the Gusu Lan Clan.

cast.name: Meng Ziyi
cast.bio: Chinese actress who plays Wen Qing, a skilled physician of the Wen Clan and Wen Ning's elder sister.

cast.name: Zhu Zanjin
cast.bio: Chinese actor who plays Jin Guangyao, a prominent member of the Lanling Jin Clan with a complicated past.

cast.name: Cao Yuchen
cast.bio: Chinese actor who plays Jin Zixuan, a young cultivator of the Lanling Jin Clan and Jiang Yanli's husband.

title: Love O2O
description: A beautiful computer science student and a top gamer meet in an online game and their in-game romance spills into real life.
story: Bei Wei Wei is a talented and beautiful computer science student who is known as the top female player in a popular online RPG. She is approached by Xiao Nai, the most sought-after student on campus and also the best player in the game, to become his in-game wife. As their virtual relationship blossoms, so does their real-world one - but jealousy, rivalry, and past wounds threaten to keep them apart.

title: Diriliş: Ertuğrul
description: The epic story of Ertuğrul, father of Ottoman Empire founder Osman I, and his tribe's fight for survival and justice.
story: Set in the 13th century, Diriliş: Ertuğrul follows the heroic Ertuğrul Bey, leader of the Kayı tribe, as he fights against the Mongol invasion and the treacherous Knights Templar while also struggling with inner conflicts within his own tribe. His valor, faith, and cunning leadership lay the foundation for what would eventually become the vast Ottoman Empire. A sweeping historical epic full of battles, betrayal, and brotherhood.

title: Kara Sevda
description: A passionate love story between two people from different worlds whose lives become entangled in tragedy and obsession.
story: Kemal is a hardworking young man from a humble background who falls deeply in love with Nihan, a beautiful woman from a wealthy and complicated family. Their relationship is opposed by her family and further complicated by Emir, a powerful and manipulative man who is determined to keep Nihan for himself. The series is a dramatic, intense portrayal of love, sacrifice, and the destructive power of obsession.

cast.name: Burak Özçivit
cast.bio: Turkish actor who plays Kemal Soydere, a young engineer whose life becomes deeply connected with Nihan.

cast.name: Neslihan Atagül
cast.bio: Turkish actress who plays Nihan Sezin, a young woman caught between her family circumstances and her love for Kemal.

cast.name: Kaan Urgancıoğlu
cast.bio: Turkish actor who plays Emir Kozcuoğlu, a wealthy businessman and Kemal's main rival.

title: Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne?
description: A young woman's fight for justice after a horrific crime changes her life and challenges the society around her.
story: Fatmagül is a simple, kind-hearted young woman living in a small Turkish town on the Aegean coast, about to be married to her childhood sweetheart. Her life is shattered when she becomes the victim of a violent assault committed by a group of wealthy young men. The series follows her long, painful battle for justice in a society quick to blame the victim, and her unexpected bond with Kerim, one of the perpetrators who was coerced into participating.

title: Squid Game
description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in deadly children's games for a huge cash prize.
story: Seong Gi-hun, a divorced father drowning in debt, is recruited into a secret survival competition where hundreds of desperate contestants play childhood games with deadly consequences for a massive cash prize.

cast.name: Lee Jung-jae
cast.bio: South Korean actor who plays Seong Gi-hun, the central character who becomes deeply determined to uncover the truth behind the game.

cast.name: Park Hae-soo
cast.bio: South Korean actor who plays Cho Sang-woo, Gi-hun's childhood friend and a highly educated contestant facing serious financial problems.

cast.name: Jung Ho-yeon
cast.bio: South Korean actress and model who plays Kang Sae-byeok, a determined contestant with a strong motivation to help her family.

title: Business Proposal
description: A woman goes on a blind date pretending to be someone else, only to discover her date is her own CEO.
story: Ha-ri agrees to a blind date pretending to be her friend, planning to sabotage it - but the man turns out to be her company's young CEO, leading to a fake-dating arrangement that slowly becomes real.

title: Vincenzo
description: A Korean-Italian mafia lawyer returns to Korea and uses his ruthless methods to take down a corrupt corporation.
story: Vincenzo Cassano, raised in Italy and adopted into the mafia, returns to Korea to retrieve hidden gold - and ends up using his mob tactics to fight a corrupt conglomerate alongside a fierce lawyer.

title: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
description: A city dentist moves to a seaside village and clashes, then falls for, the town's do-it-all handyman.
story: Yoon Hye-jin sets up a dental practice in the small coastal village of Gongjin, where she repeatedly bumps heads - and eventually falls in love - with Hong Du-sik, the warm-hearted jack-of-all-trades everyone in town relies on.

title: It's Okay to Not Be Okay
description: A psychiatric ward caregiver and an antisocial children's book author heal each other's emotional wounds.
story: Moon Gang-tae, who cares for his autistic older brother while working at a psychiatric hospital, crosses paths with Ko Moon-young, a successful but emotionally guarded children's book author, and the two begin to heal each other's deep-rooted trauma.

title: Reply 1988
description: Five childhood friends and their families navigate life, love, and growing up in 1980s Seoul.
story: Set in a close-knit Seoul neighborhood in 1988, five friends grow up together through school, first loves, and family struggles, in a nostalgic look at friendship and coming of age.

title: True Beauty
description: A girl who transforms herself with makeup navigates high school romance while hiding her bare face.
story: Lim Ju-kyung, once bullied for her appearance, masters makeup to reinvent herself at a new school, but must keep her bare face a secret while falling for two very different classmates.

cast.name: Moon Ga-young
cast.bio: South Korean actress born July 10, 1996 in Karlsruhe, Germany. Started as a child actress in 2006 and gained major recognition through her lead role in True Beauty.

cast.name: Cha Eun-woo
cast.bio: South Korean singer and actor, born Lee Dong-min on March 30, 1997 in Gunpo. Member of boy band Astro; True Beauty brought him international recognition.

cast.name: Hwang In-yeop
cast.bio: South Korean actor and model born January 19, 1991. Started as a runway model before his acting debut, later known for The Tale of Nokdu, 18 Again, and True Beauty.

title: The Glory
description: A woman devises a meticulous plan to take revenge on the classmates who brutally bullied her in school.
story: After enduring horrific bullying in high school that left her scarred for life, Moon Dong-eun spends years carefully orchestrating an elaborate revenge plan against her former tormentors.

title: Twenty-Five Twenty-One
description: During the 1998 financial crisis, a passionate fencer and a once-wealthy young man form a bittersweet bond.
story: Amid South Korea's 1997 financial crisis, aspiring fencer Na Hee-do fights to keep her Olympic dream alive while forming a deep connection with Baek Yi-jin, a young man whose family fortune collapsed overnight.

title: Descendants of the Sun
description: A special forces captain and a surgeon fall in love while navigating duty, danger, and disaster relief abroad.
story: Captain Yoo Si-jin of a special forces unit and surgeon Kang Mo-yeon reconnect on a humanitarian mission overseas, where their romance is tested by military duty, natural disasters, and personal sacrifice.

title: Start-Up
description: Young entrepreneurs chase their startup dreams in Korea's version of Silicon Valley while navigating a tangled love triangle.
story: Seo Dal-mi dreams of becoming an entrepreneur and reconnects with a childhood pen pal, only to find her path intertwined with two young men - one pretending to be that pen pal - as they all build startups in a competitive tech incubator.

title: Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-joo
description: A college weightlifter navigates friendship, ambition, and an unexpected romance with a competitive swimmer.
story: Kim Bok-joo, a talented but insecure weightlifter at a sports university, grows in confidence both in and out of the gym as she falls for her childhood friend, a swimmer chasing his own Olympic dream.

title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
description: Spanning decades on Jeju Island starting in the 1950s, the story follows Ae-sun and Gwan-sik as their bond grows from childhood into a lifelong relationship, set against the backdrop of the island's tangerine farms.

title: Melo Movie
description: A film critic and an aspiring director cross paths through their shared love of cinema, navigating a slow-burn romance shaped by their complicated family histories.

title: Weak Hero Class 2
description: The second chapter continues the story of students caught between school violence and personal survival, expanding on the world introduced in the first season.

title: Yulje Medical Center (Spin-off)
description: First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the pressures of training while balancing their personal lives, in a spin-off set within the same hospital universe.

title: Trigger
description: After firearms unexpectedly become widely available in South Korea, a normally gun-free country, two men become entangled in the fallout of the crisis.

title: Us and Them
description: Two former lovers cross paths on a flight to Korea, stirring up memories of a chance meeting years earlier before life pulled them apart.
